title: Analogical Reasoning in Human-AI Collaborative Software Engineering
body_excerpt: This workshop paper examines how developers use structural, functional, process, and cross-domain analogies when communicating with AI agents such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code. We find functional analogies are most effective during debugging phases.
author: demo_user_3

title: Empirical Study on Developer Mental Models for Agentic Coding Tools
body_excerpt: We surveyed 52 developers about analogy usage with AI agents. Similar to prior work on program comprehension metaphors, we find that analogies improve critical thinking but can introduce analogical complacency when too compelling.
author: demo_user_4
